header: Business As Usual (Bau) Secure Practices Policy Summary
text: This FiftyFive Technologies Policy on business as usual secure practices policy is released for use in FiftyFive Technologies Pvt Limited with effect from 01 January 2026. This document is subject to FiftyFive Technologies Pvt Limited Procedure and subject to change at any time as per the company policy.
policy_name: Business As Usual (Bau) Secure Practices Policy
source_file: Business As Usual (BAU) Secure Practices Policy.pdf
doc_name: Business As Usual (Bau) Secure Practices Policy

header: Business As Usual (Bau) Secure Practices Policy Rule 1
text: Introduction This document establishes the standard security practices and procedures to be followed by all employees, contractors, and third-party vendors of FiftyFive Technologies during their day-to-day activities. The BAU Secure Practices policy aims to protect the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of the organization's information assets and mitigate the risk of security incidents.
policy_name: Business As Usual (Bau) Secure Practices Policy
source_file: Business As Usual (BAU) Secure Practices Policy.pdf
doc_name: Business As Usual (Bau) Secure Practices Policy

header: Business As Usual (Bau) Secure Practices Policy Rule 2
text: Scope This policy applies to all individuals who have access to FiftyFive Technologies's systems, networks, applications, and data, regardless of their role or position within the organization. It encompasses activities conducted on company premises, remote locations, and while using company-issued or personal devices to access company resources.
